method.workflow: fresh model proposal -> production validation/authorization/sign -> production server verification/freshness/authorization/replay/read_file -> fresh display-only model summary
method.pair_order: Ed25519 then ML-DSA-44 in odd pairs; reversed in even pairs, independently within each phase
method.pacing: between complete workflows, not between proposal and summary within a workflow
method.model_request_count_note: counts attempted propose/summarize methods; successful workflows have two real HTTP requests for the production live adapter
method.statistics_population: successful measured samples only; complete measured pairs for paired differences
method.timing_accounting: inclusive aggregate stages must not be summed with their children; residual local stages include instrumentation and glue overhead

comparison.total_difference_interpretation: observed, not causal: independent Gemini calls contain API/network/response-length noise
